sections.title: Section II — Free Response
sections.notes: 4 questions requiring complete analytical justification. Graphing calculator permitted throughout.

pool.domain: Unit 4 · Functions Involving Parameters, Vectors, and Matrices
pool.text: Primary oscillator [APPC-0] operates under the relation the linear operator matrix \( A = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 4 \end{pmatrix} \). What is the sum of the eigenvalues (the trace \( \text{tr}(A) \))?
pool.sol: The sum of the eigenvalues of any square matrix equals its trace (the sum of the main diagonal entries): \( \text{tr}(A) = 2 + 4 = 6 \).

pool.domain: Unit 4 · Functions Involving Parameters, Vectors, and Matrices
pool.text: Find the component form of vector \( \mathbf{u} \) directed from \( (3, 6) \) to \( (8, -2) \).
pool.sol: \( \mathbf{u} = \langle (8) - (3), (-2) - (6) \rangle = \langle 5, -8 \rangle \).

pool.text: Eliminate the parameter to find \(y\) as a function of \(x\): \(x=1t-2\), \(y=-2t^2\).
pool.sol: From \(x=1t-2\), \(t=\dfrac{x+2}{1}\). Substitute into \(y=-2t^2\): \(y=-2\left(\dfrac{x+2}{1}\right)^2=-2(x+2)^2.\)
